Weekend Itinerary

October 2

Welcome Drinks

3pm–6pm

Tallboy — 4210 Telegraph Ave.

Google Maps (clickable):

Come enjoy some cocktails with us at one of our favorite local haunts. If you're feeling peckish they also have vegan hotdogs and popcorn!

Event is child-friendly; however the venue is a bar, so under-21s will need to leave by 6pm when it reopens to the general public.

October 3

Ceremony + Reception — “A MYSTERIOUS and PORTENTOUS RITUAL”

Arrive for the ceremony by 3:30pm

Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts — 10 10th St.

Google Maps (clickable):

Join us for the main event at the HJK's Lakeview Terrace! The venue is partly indoors and partly outdoors, but the terrace is on the north side of the building so at this time of year it should be in shade for almost the full event. More details about venue access are on the Hotel + Transit tab.

Afterparty at Mad Oak Bar 'N' Yard

10:30pm–midnight

Just a couple blocks away at 135 12th St.

After-afterparty..... IYKYK ;)

October 4

Farewell Brunch

11am–2pm

Hella Bees — 2340 Harrison St.

Google Maps (clickable):

We'd love to see folks one last time before you scatter back to the four winds! Eat some tasty food and nurse your hangover with us. Arrive whenever (but we can't promise how much food will be left if you get there toward the end.)
